issues.on_page: Line 2 Investments 37,636.92 (General); line 3 subtotal 147,403.00 already includes it
issues.issue: beginning_cash (178,995.77) and ending_cash (206,408.92) are the line 3 / line 24 subtotals that already include investments (37,636.92 / 38,295.21), and beginning/ending_investments repeat them. This is allowed because investments are informational, but anyone who adds cash and investments will count the investments twice.

issues.on_page: Local Receipts: Other: General 38,024.02, Street 6,525.65, Fire 116,103.76, Park 6,558.24
issues.issue: The page does not say what these are, so other is defensible. But it is 55% of governmental receipts, and the Fire Fund's 116,103.76 is almost all of that fund's money (probably rural fire contracts or payments from other governments). The same applies to the Water/Sewer Local Receipts: Other 169,516.02 (receipts[11], detail Water/Sewer), which are probably utility charges. These are context labels, so the context check should settle them.
